purpose: Predeclare comparator definitions, consequence scaling, action costs, execution-risk budgets, and post-GATHER continuation rules before running the RCSE policy simulation.

ARGMAX.description: Choose the highest calibrated t0 action probability among EXECUTE/GATHER/ESCALATE/ABSTAIN. This is a predictive-action baseline and does not use transaction consequence.

CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.description: EXECUTE if p_cal_execute >= tau0; otherwise ESCALATE. GATHER and ABSTAIN are not used. This isolates fixed-confidence selective execution.

COST_AWARE_BLIND.description: Consequence-blind expected-loss policy. Uses C(v)=1, does not use GATHER, and chooses minimum loss among EXECUTE/ESCALATE/ABSTAIN.

VOI_BLIND.description: Consequence-blind one-step GATHER policy. Uses C(v)=1. GATHER is available only for Step-09b.1 eligible natural delayed-evidence episodes.

RCSE_NO_GATHER.description: Consequence-aware RCSE ablation without GATHER. Uses exposure-scaled execution loss and explicit consequence-weighted execution-risk budget.

RCSE_FULL.description: Full consequence-aware RCSE with EXECUTE/GATHER/ESCALATE/ABSTAIN, exposure-scaled loss, execution-risk budget, and one-step post-GATHER continuation.

primary.name: LOG_TRAIN_P90
primary.v_ref_definition: 90th percentile of absolute transaction exposure computed from the TRAIN partition of the corresponding frozen regime. Never compute v_ref from the test partition.

sensitivity.name: LOG_TRAIN_P50
sensitivity.v_ref_definition: 50th percentile of absolute exposure from the TRAIN partition of the corresponding frozen regime.

sensitivity.name: LOG_TRAIN_P99
sensitivity.v_ref_definition: 99th percentile of absolute exposure from the TRAIN partition of the corresponding frozen regime.

execute.interpretation: Expected autonomous-execution loss from residual probability that EXECUTE is not the benchmark-appropriate t0 response.

gather.availability: Only when gather_policy_eligible=True in the Step-09b.1 policy-ready dataset.
gather.post_execute_feasibility: Post-GATHER autonomous EXECUTE is allowed only if BOTH p_safe_t1_for_primary_rcse >= tau1 AND (1 - p_safe_t1_for_primary_rcse) * C(v) <= beta1. Otherwise post-GATHER continuation falls back to min(ESCALATE, ABSTAIN).
gather.important_limitation: q_t1 is treated as an auxiliary selective score, not as a universally calibrated safety probability. No special R4 override is introduced in the primary policy.

reference_cost_schedule.note: These are reference experimental costs for figures/tables, not claimed enterprise monetary costs.

cost_sensitivity_grid.constraint: Only evaluate combinations satisfying c_G < c_H < c_A.

risk_budget.definition: Consequence-weighted execution-risk budget: (1 - p_execute) * C(v) <= beta0.
risk_budget.note: This continuous consequence-weighted budget replaces arbitrary hand-set R1/R2/R3/R4 confidence multipliers in the primary policy.

post_gather_gate.rule: Post-GATHER execute only when q_t1 >= tau1 and (1-q_t1)*C(v) <= beta1; otherwise ESCALATE/ABSTAIN fallback.
post_gather_gate.test_result_safeguard: No regime-specific threshold or R4-only rule may be introduced in the primary analysis after seeing Step-09a.5 test results.

primary_reference_configuration.usage: Illustrative/reference operating configuration only. Main claims must be based on policy frontiers and sensitivity ranges, not one chosen parameter point.

test_set_governance: Do not choose a single tau0, beta0, tau1, beta1, or cost schedule because it looks best on the test set.
Report predeclared grids/frontiers and the frozen reference configuration.
Training-only statistics may be used for consequence normalization; test outcomes may not be used to redefine policy parameters.
Step-09a.5 risk-cap operating points are descriptive diagnostics and are not reused as prospectively tuned thresholds.
No special R4 policy override is permitted in the primary analysis.
